title: Remove legacy product-price inventory creation input
plan: Accept only product_variant_id in POST /api/inventories and reject unknown legacy product_price_id fields.
Remove repository create fallback that resolves a variant from product_price_id; preserve derived product_price_id in inventory responses and existing price lookup reads.
Update API and PostgreSQL integration fixtures to create inventories through variants, then run focused and integration validation.
contract: Inventory creation is variant-based. product_price_id is not accepted in create requests, while inventory response product_price_id remains a derived field.
